Ather vs Ather

Ather Konarc vs 450X

The Konarc starts about ₹49,000 below the 450X at ex-showroom prices. That is a big gap, and for many riders the Konarc does everything they need. For others, the 450X's speed and technology are the point. Here is where the line falls.

Updated 12 November 2026 · 2 min read · Pillai Auto, authorised Ather dealer

Ather Konarc vs 450X

On this page

  1. The big differences
  2. What the extra money buys
  3. What you keep by saving
  4. A simple test

The big differences

Konarc S (3.5 kWh)450X (3.5 kWh)
Peak power4.7 kW6.4 kW
Top speed70 km/h90 km/h
0–40 km/h4.7 s3.3 s
TrueRange130 km130 km
Dashboard7-inch DeepView7-inch touchscreen, Google Maps
Rider aidsAutoHold, FallSafe, Reverse Park AssistPlus Warp, traction control, Magic Twist, Infinite Cruise
Ather Grid, 10 minup to 15 kmup to 30 km
Boot31 L22 L
Service interval1 yearEvery 5,000 km or 6 months

What the extra money buys

Mostly performance and technology: 20 km/h more top speed, much quicker acceleration, a touchscreen with Google Maps, traction control for wet roads, Infinite Cruise for traffic, and fast charging at twice the rate. If you value those every day, the 450X is worth it.

What you keep by saving

The same real-world range with the 3.5 kWh battery, a bigger boot, a more comfortable ride on bad roads, and lower maintenance. For a commute that never goes above 60 km/h, the Konarc gives up surprisingly little.

A simple test

Look at your daily route. If more than a quarter of it is open road where traffic moves above 60 km/h, test ride the 450X. If it is mostly city streets and service roads, the Konarc will serve you well and the savings can go towards the extended battery warranty and a good helmet.

Questions we get asked

At ex-showroom prices, the Konarc S starts at an introductory ₹99,999 and the 450X at ₹1,48,998 — a gap of about ₹49,000 at the entry level.

With the 3.5 kWh battery, both have a TrueRange estimate of about 130 km.

Not on the Konarc S. Ather lists Google Maps for the upcoming Konarc Z.
